repos.name: SilverSprint
repos.description: SilverSprint is a "Neural-First" training platform. It operates on the principle that for aging sprinters, Central Nervous System (CNS) recovery is the primary bottleneck for performance. The application must automate the detection of neural fatigue and provide actionable "Go/No-Go" training recommendations.
